headline: The Commodore Keyboard Finds a New Typeface
lede: Photographs of classic Commodore 64 keycaps become a working digital font. The project preserves the machine’s lettering, function labels, and PETSCII symbols in files made for modern screens.

headline: How One Molecule Gets the Winning Hand
lede: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai receive the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for explaining how molecular handedness can amplify itself. Their work connects asymmetric synthesis to the chemistry of life and the design of medicines.

headline: AI Opens a New File in Mathematics
lede: OpenAI is publishing model-generated mathematical results alongside papers, Lean proofs, reasoning summaries, and compute estimates. The release makes verification and attribution part of the artifact, not an afterthought.
pullquote: A mathematical result matters only when the community can inspect how it stands.

headline: A Small Model Makes Fast Decisions
lede: Strands Decider 2B is an open-source model built to choose, score, and route—not to write essays. Running locally in roughly 115 milliseconds on an RTX 3090, it targets the narrow decisions that larger agents repeatedly outsource.

headline: Decisions API Ships a Typed Shortcut
lede: Public beta. Predicate questions, fixed choices, ordered scores. OpenAI’s endpoint returns probabilities and confidence values for classification, routing, image review, and triage—at a claimed tenth of the latency of Responses.

headline: Mistral Brings a Trillion Parameters Online
lede: Mistral Large 4 arrives in preview as a one-trillion-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model, with 49 billion active parameters. It runs on European infrastructure and is aimed at coding, agents, security, science, and private enterprise deployments.

headline: WebGPU Turns Interfaces Into Moving Ink
lede: More than 200 shader effects bring gradients, noise, glass, lighting, and transitions to React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and plain JavaScript. The library makes GPU spectacle composable—whether the page needs it or simply wants to shimmer.

headline: Embeddings Slip the Cloud’s Leash
lede: EmbeddingGemma 2 places text, code, images, video, and audio in a shared vector space. Its open license, quantized inference, and consumer-hardware footprint make local, privacy-preserving retrieval a practical target rather than a distant promise.

headline: A Two-Dollar Chip Blocks the Web
lede: This ESP32-C3 project turns a tiny microcontroller into a network-wide DNS sinkhole. Sorted 40-bit hashes fit more than 140,000 domains into flash, while the build documents the less glamorous constraints: collisions, updates, and an unsecured setup portal.

headline: Codemode Gives Agents a Workbench
lede: Instead of exposing every tool directly to a model, Codemode lets an agent write and run sandboxed JavaScript on the trusted harness side. The result is a more stateful way to compose calls, process large outputs, and manage concurrency—alongside fresh questions about durability and boundaries.
